Sparse Newton’s Method Newton’s method is a powerful method for numerical approximation. Under desirable conditions, it may converge rapidly, which provides a framework for designing not only sequential but also parallel algorithms. However, one of the major drawbacks of Newton’s method when applying to matrix functions, such as the ones consider in this paper, is that it may introduce dense matrix multiplications, even if the original matrix is sparse. Thus, when dealing with large-scale matrices, the intermediate computation for Newton’s method could be prohibitively expensive.
